rows.question: Show the name of institutions based in Nordjylland
rows.pred_sql:
WITH institutions_with_eu_region AS (
SELECT
  i.unics_id AS unics_id,
  i.institutions_name AS institutions_name,
  i.geocode_regions_3 AS geocode_regions_3,
  i.geocode_regions_3 AS region_name,
  e.geocode_regions AS eu_geocode_regions,
  e.description AS eu_description,

FROM institutions i
LEFT JOIN eu_territorial_units e
  ON i.geocode_regions_3 = e.geocode_regions
),
eu_territorial_units_core AS (
SELECT
  geocode_regions::text AS geocode_regions,
  description::text AS description,
  geocode_level::integer AS geocode_level,

FROM eu_territorial_units
)
SELECT institutions_name
FROM institutions_with_eu_region
WHERE eu_description = 'Nordjylland'
   OR eu_geocode_regions = 'Nordjylland'

rows.question: Show the acronym and subject area description of projects with subject area “Mathematics and Statistics”
rows.pred_sql:
WITH project_subject_area_membership AS (
  SELECT
    psm.project                       AS project_unics_id,
    psm.subject_area                  AS subject_area_value,
    sa.title                          AS subject_area_title,
    sa.code                           AS subject_area_code,
    sa.description                    AS subject_area_description
  FROM project_subject_areas psm
  LEFT JOIN subject_areas sa
    ON sa.code = psm.subject_area
    OR sa.title = psm.subject_area
)
SELECT
  p.acronym,
  psa.subject_area_description AS description
FROM project_subject_area_membership psa
JOIN projects p
  ON psa.project_unics_id = p.unics_id
WHERE
  -- require that the project's subject area value corresponds to 'Mathematics and Statistics'
  psa.subject_area_value = 'Mathematics and Statistics'
  -- and ensure we have a matched canonical subject area row (so description is available)
  AND psa.subject_area_description IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY p.acronym

rows.question: Find all different topics of projects that ended in 2014
rows.pred_sql:
WITH projects_with_programmes_subjects_topics AS (
  SELECT
    p.unics_id AS unics_id,
    pt.topic AS topic
  FROM projects p
  LEFT JOIN project_topics pt ON pt.project = p.unics_id
),
project_topics_link AS (
  SELECT
    pwt.unics_id AS project,
    pwt.topic AS topic
  FROM projects_with_programmes_subjects_topics pwt
  WHERE pwt.topic IS NOT NULL AND pwt.topic <> ''
),
topics_canonical AS (
  SELECT
    code,
    trim(both ' ' FROM nullif(regexp_replace(title, '\s+', ' ', 'g'), '')) AS title
  FROM topics
)
SELECT DISTINCT tc.code, tc.title
FROM projects p
JOIN project_topics_link pt ON p.unics_id = pt.project
JOIN topics_canonical tc ON pt.topic = tc.code
WHERE p.end_date BETWEEN DATE '2014-01-01' AND DATE '2014-12-31'
ORDER BY tc.code

rows.question: Find the id of projects with at least 100 members
rows.pred_sql:
SELECT
  p.unics_id AS project_id
FROM
  projects p
JOIN (
  SELECT
    pm.project,
    COUNT(DISTINCT pm.unics_id) AS distinct_member_unics_count
  FROM
    project_members pm
  WHERE
    pm.project IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY
    pm.project
) m ON m.project = p.unics_id
WHERE
  m.distinct_member_unics_count >= 100
ORDER BY
  p.unics_id

rows.question: Find the projects which lasted the longest and have an end year and a start year
rows.pred_sql:
WITH projects_core AS (
  SELECT
    unics_id,
    acronym,
    title,
    start_year,
    end_year
  FROM projects
),
projects_with_years_and_duration AS (
  SELECT
    p.unics_id,
    p.acronym,
    p.title,
    p.start_year,
    p.end_year,
    CASE
      WHEN p.start_year IS NOT NULL AND p.end_year IS NOT NULL THEN (p.end_year - p.start_year)
      ELSE NULL
    END AS duration_years
  FROM projects_core p
)
SELECT
  unics_id,
  acronym,
  title,
  start_year,
  end_year,
  duration_years
FROM projects_with_years_and_duration
WHERE start_year IS NOT NULL
  AND end_year IS NOT NULL
  AND duration_years = (
    SELECT MAX(duration_years)
    FROM projects_with_years_and_duration
    WHERE start_year IS NOT NULL AND end_year IS NOT NULL
  )
ORDER BY duration_years DESC, unics_id ASC
